title: Skull Buster GB
description:
A fixed-screen arcade shooter, a Game Boy demake of Skulls, the PICO-8 game by Jakub "Jimmac" Steiner, using his original graphics with permission. Fight through 20 waves of skull enemies with 5 lives, including a miniboss and a final boss at wave 20. Made for the Game Boy Color, it also runs on the original Game Boy and has a Super Game Boy border. Features a high score table with initials entry and statistics saved to battery-backed SRAM, 5 music tracks by MuteAudio (hUGEDriver) and 12 sound effects (CBT-FX).

Controls: D-Pad moves the ship, A shoots, Start pauses, Select toggles mute.
